title: Innokin Plexus Go Pod Vape Kit
description: The Innokin Plexus Go is a lightweight, classic pen-style pod kit designed for simple, all-day MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. A 1000mAh built-in battery delivers up to 16W with 0.01s inhale activation, so there are no buttons or settings to manage. The 2ml Plexus cartridge features a 360° transparent design and a clean top-sliding refill, plus a side airflow slider to fine-tune the draw from tight to slightly looser MTL. The kit includes a 0.8ohm mesh cartridge (best around 13–16W). Additional Plexus cartridges are available in 0.6ohm dual-mesh for a warmer, fuller draw and 1.2ohm mesh for a cooler, gentler inhale. Finished in stainless steel and pocket-friendly in size, Plexus Go is an easy choice for new vapers and anyone who wants a straightforward daily device. Colours: Sakura Pink, Frost Blue, Indigo Blue, Moonlight Silver, Midnight Black. Browse our vape juice and find the perfect flavour to match this kit. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Pods, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
